card.name: Malay text and word-start pieces
card.fires_on: Strongest in Malay-language historical text, on word pieces such as 'peng', 'meny', 'di' before a verb, and place names like Indonesia. Also fires on scattered pieces of names and encoded text in other languages.

modes.label: Malay word beginnings
modes.description: Prefix-like pieces at the start of Malay words, or capitalised place names, in a Malay passage about Malaysia.
modes.example: Saya memetik tulisan yang di buat<< peng>>arang bagi makluman semua tentang

modes.label: Other names and codes
modes.description: Scattered pieces in English or mixed-language text, such as an organisation name or a URL-encoded character.
modes.example: president of the<< American>> Clinical Laboratory Association, a Washington-based industry

card.plain: It mostly lights up on pieces of words in an old Malay-language passage, with a few unrelated hits elsewhere.
